content.translation: 星期五了！我们周五有美术课。我们喜欢美术。

content.text: Sorry, everyone. Ms Li is not well today.
content.translation: 抱歉，同学们。李老师今天不舒服。

content.text: Oh... No art today!
content.translation: 哦……今天没有美术课！

content.text: Let's do something for Ms Li.
content.translation: 我们为李老师做点什么吧。

content.text: Good idea!
content.translation: 好主意！

content.text: It's Monday. Let's go and visit our old friends this Sunday!
content.translation: 星期一。我们这周日去拜访老朋友吧！

content.text: Great!
content.translation: 好！

content.text: It's Tuesday. I want to make some bookmarks for Grandma Guo. She likes reading.
content.translation: 星期二。我想给郭奶奶做些书签。她喜欢读书。

content.text: It's Wednesday. I want to make a stick for Grandpa Liu.
content.translation: 星期三。我想给刘爷爷做一根拐杖。

content.text: It's Thursday. What about a painting for Grandma Zhang?
content.translation: 星期四。给张奶奶画幅画怎么样？

content.text: It's Friday. Dad, I want some tea. It's for Grandpa Ma.
content.translation: 星期五。爸爸，我想要些茶。给马爷爷的。

content.text: It's Saturday. Mum, I want some flowers for Granny Ning.
content.translation: 星期六。妈妈，我想要些花送给宁奶奶。

content.text: Sure.
content.translation: 当然可以。

content.text: It's Sunday. Thank you so much, Wenwen!
content.translation: 星期日。太谢谢你了，文文！

content.text: Can you jump high, Daming?
content.translation: 大明，你能跳得高吗？

content.text: Yes, I can.
content.translation: 是的，我能。

content.text: Can you run fast?
content.translation: 你能跑得快吗？

content.text: Yes, I can.
content.translation: 是的，我能。

content.text: Can you play ping-pong?
content.translation: 你会打乒乓球吗？

content.text: Yes, I can.
content.translation: 是的，我会。

content.text: Can you swim?
content.translation: 你会游泳吗？

content.text: No, I can't. But I can learn.
content.translation: 不，我不会。但是我可以学。

content.text: I can swim now!
content.translation: 我现在会游泳啦！

content.text: Wow! You can swim fast!
content.translation: 哇！你游得真快！

content.text: I'm Terry Fox. I like running and playing basketball.
content.translation: 我是特里·福克斯。我喜欢跑步和打篮球。

content.text: But I lose one leg because of cancer.
content.translation: 但因为癌症，我失去了一条腿。

content.text: Can I help other people with cancer?
content.translation: 我能帮助其他癌症患者吗？

content.text: I know! I can run across Canada. And I can get money for people!
content.translation: 我想到了！我可以跑步穿越加拿大，还能为人们筹集善款！

content.text: It's hard for me. Many kind people help me.
content.translation: 这对我来说很难。许多善良的人帮助我。

content.text: Yes, I can do it!
content.translation: 是的，我能做到！

content.text: Come on, Terry! You can do it!
content.translation: 加油，特里！你能做到！

content.text: I keep running for five months.
content.translation: 我坚持跑了五个月。

content.text: But I'm very ill. I can't run anymore.
content.translation: 但我病得很重。我再也跑不动了。

content.text: Now many people do the Terry Fox Run every year.
content.translation: 现在每年都有很多人参加特里·福克斯长跑。

content.text: Let's remember Terry with a run.
content.translation: 让我们用长跑纪念特里。

content.text: Dad, may I play outside?
content.translation: 爸爸，我可以出去玩吗？

content.text: Yes. But can you tidy your room first?
content.translation: 可以。但是你能先整理一下你的房间吗？

content.text: OK. That's easy.
content.translation: 好的。那很容易。

content.text: Bobby, can you help me clean the floor?
content.translation: 博比，你能帮我擦地板吗？

content.text: Woof! Woof!
content.translation: 汪！汪！

content.text: Go, Bobby! Good job!
content.translation: 加油，博比！干得好！

content.text: Bobby, stop! Look! It's so dirty now!
content.translation: 博比，停下！看！现在太脏了！

content.text: Woof! Woof!
content.translation: 汪！汪！

content.text: Sam, are you still busy?
content.translation: 萨姆，你还在忙吗？

content.text: Yes, Dad. I need to clean the floor, the desk and the wall.
content.translation: 是的，爸爸。我需要擦地板、桌子和墙。

content.text: Woof! Woof!
content.translation: 汪！汪！

content.text: I'm Yao Qinwen. This is my family. My dad is ill. My grandma is old. My mum is busy. I must help!
content.translation: 我是姚勤文。这是我的家庭。我爸爸生病了。我奶奶年纪大了。我妈妈很忙。我必须帮忙！

content.text: I take care of Dad.
content.translation: 我照顾爸爸。

content.text: Can I make the bed for you, Dad?
content.translation: 爸爸，我能帮你整理床铺吗？

content.text: Thank you, Wenwen.
content.translation: 谢谢你，文文。

content.text: I take care of Grandma.
content.translation: 我照顾奶奶。

content.text: Wenwen, can you help clean the room?
content.translation: 文文，你能帮忙打扫房间吗？

content.text: Sure!
content.translation: 当然可以！

content.text: Sometimes Mum feels tired. I take care of her, too.
content.translation: 有时妈妈觉得累。我也照顾她。

content.text: May I help you wash the dishes, Mum?
content.translation: 妈妈，我可以帮你洗碗吗？

content.text: Thank you, my dear!
content.translation: 谢谢你，亲爱的！

content.text: Wenwen is so helpful. She is the sunshine of our family.
content.translation: 文文很乐于帮忙。她是我们家的阳光。

content.text: I'm happy to warm up my family!
content.translation: 我很高兴能温暖我的家人！

Unit 3 What's the weather like?.unit: Unit 3 What's the weather like? (Start up)

content.text: What's the weather like?
content.translation: 天气怎么样？

content.text: It's sunny and warm. We can go out to play.
content.translation: 天气晴朗又暖和。我们可以出去玩。

content.text: Oh, it's cool!
content.translation: 哦，真凉爽！

content.text: It's windy and cloudy. Let's go home!
content.translation: 刮风又阴天。我们回家吧！

content.text: Oh! It's rainy now. Let's run!
content.translation: 哦！现在下雨了。我们快跑吧！

content.text: Look! I've got a good idea.
content.translation: 看！我有一个好主意。

content.text: Our umbrellas are great!
content.translation: 我们的雨伞太棒了！

content.text: Look! Let's go and help!
content.translation: 看！我们去帮忙吧！

content.text: Thank you.
content.translation: 谢谢你们。

Unit 3 What's the weather like?.unit: Unit 3 What's the weather like? (Speed up)

content.text: Liu Fei is a teacher at a children's home in Sanya.
content.translation: 刘菲是三亚一家儿童之家的老师。

content.text: What is snow like?
content.translation: 雪是什么样的？

content.text: Does it taste like ice cream?
content.translation: 它尝起来像冰淇淋吗？

content.text: Liu Fei calls her friend Lin Jia in Harbin.
content.translation: 刘菲给在哈尔滨的朋友林佳打电话。

content.text: Hey, what's the weather like there today?
content.translation: 嗨，今天那里的天气怎么样？

content.text: It's snowy and cold.
content.translation: 下雪了，很冷。

content.text: The children here want to see real snow. But it's hot in Sanya. It never snows.
content.translation: 这里的孩子们想看看真正的雪。但是三亚很热，从不下雪。

content.text: Two days later, Liu Fei gets a big surprise.
content.translation: 两天后，刘菲收到了一个大惊喜。

content.text: Liu Fei, here is some snow for the children. I hope they like it! Love, Lin Jia
content.translation: 刘菲，这是给孩子们的一些雪。希望他们喜欢！爱你的林佳

content.text: Liu Fei takes the snow to the children's home.
content.translation: 刘菲把雪带到了儿童之家。

content.text: Look! Real snow!
content.translation: 看！真正的雪！

content.text: It's cool!
content.translation: 太酷了！

content.text: Hooray!
content.translation: 万岁！

content.text: Ms Lin Jia, Thank you!
content.translation: 林佳女士，谢谢您！

content.text: We love our snowy day!
content.translation: 我们喜欢我们的下雪天！

content.text: What's your favourite season, friends?
content.translation: 孩子们，你们最喜欢哪个季节？

content.text: I like winter best. I can play in the snow.
content.translation: 我最喜欢冬天。我可以在雪里玩。

content.text: I don't like winter. It's cold. I like spring and autumn. They are beautiful.
content.translation: 我不喜欢冬天。冬天很冷。我喜欢春天和秋天。它们很美。

content.text: I like summer best. I can eat ice cream. What about you, Lingling?
content.translation: 我最喜欢夏天。我可以吃冰淇淋。玲玲，你呢？

content.text: I like summer best, too.
content.translation: 我也最喜欢夏天。

content.text: Why do you also like summer?
content.translation: 你为什么也喜欢夏天？

content.text: Because my birthday is in summer!
content.translation: 因为我的生日在夏天！

content.text: Ha ha!
content.translation: 哈哈！

content.text: I'm Li Han. This is my apple tree.
content.translation: 我是李涵。这是我的苹果树。

content.text: I'm ten now. The tree is ten, too. Spring is here! The birds are back.
content.translation: 我现在十岁了。这棵树也十岁了。春天来了！鸟儿回来了。

content.text: It's summer. The apple tree is like a sun umbrella. I like reading under it.
content.translation: 夏天到了。苹果树像一把太阳伞。我喜欢在树下读书。

content.text: It's autumn. I like autumn best! There are many red apples on the tree!
content.translation: 秋天到了。我最喜欢秋天！树上有很多红苹果！

content.text: Can I share the apples with my friends? Sure!
content.translation: 我能和朋友们分享这些苹果吗？当然！

content.text: It's winter. My apple tree has warm, new clothes.
content.translation: 冬天到了。我的苹果树穿上了暖和的新衣服。

content.text: A snowstorm comes. Oh, no! My apple tree! I don't like winter!
content.translation: 暴风雪来了。哦，不！我的苹果树！我不喜欢冬天！

content.text: Don't worry. Let's wait for spring.
content.translation: 别担心。让我们等待春天。

content.text: It's spring again. My apple tree grows again. Hooray!
content.translation: 春天又来了。我的苹果树又生长了。万岁！

content.text: Let's go for a picnic in the park.
content.translation: 我们去公园野餐吧。

content.text: Hooray!
content.translation: 万岁！

content.text: How do we get there?
content.translation: 我们怎么到那里？

content.text: Let's go by car! It's fast!
content.translation: 我们开车去吧！很快！

content.text: No, let's go in a "green" way!
content.translation: 不，让我们用“绿色”的方式去！

content.text: A green way?
content.translation: 绿色的方式？

content.text: Yes. Go and get ready. Let's meet in five minutes.
content.translation: 是的。去准备吧。我们五分钟后见。

content.text: We're green now! Let's go!
content.translation: 我们现在是绿色的了！出发！

content.text: Ha ha! Not that kind of green!
content.translation: 哈哈！不是那种绿色！

content.text: This kind of green!
content.translation: 是这种绿色！

content.text: Hello, I'm Jingjing. This is my friend Sihai. We live in Sichuan.
content.translation: 你好，我是晶晶。这是我的朋友四海。我们住在四川。

content.text: It's time to go to Qatar! But how do we get there? It's far away.
content.translation: 该去卡塔尔了！但是我们怎么去呢？那里很远。

content.text: Look! The truck is here. Let's go! Goodbye, everyone!
content.translation: 看！卡车来了。我们走吧！再见，大家！

content.text: Now we are on a plane in the sky. Goodbye, China!
content.translation: 现在我们在天上的飞机里。再见，中国！

content.text: What a long way! Here we are! Hello, Qatar! We go to our new home by truck.
content.translation: 好远的路啊！我们到了！你好，卡塔尔！我们坐卡车去我们的新家。

content.text: It's our new home. It's big. We've got a lot of bamboo here. It comes from China by plane!
content.translation: 这是我们的新家。它很大。我们这里有很多竹子。它们是从中国空运来的！

content.text: Many people come to see us. We've got a lot of new friends! We are happy!
content.translation: 很多人来看我们。我们交了很多新朋友！我们很开心！

content.text: My cat Susu goes out every morning! Where does she go?
content.translation: 我的猫苏苏每天早上都出去！她去哪儿了？

content.text: I don't know! Let's find out tomorrow.
content.translation: 我不知道！我们明天去弄清楚吧。

content.text: Susu goes straight on to the museum. She turns left there.
content.translation: 苏苏一直走到博物馆。她在那里向左转。

content.text: At the hospital, she turns right.
content.translation: 在医院那里，她向右转。

content.text: Then Susu stops. Let's go there!
content.translation: 然后苏苏停下了。我们去那里吧！

content.text: Go straight on to the museum. Then turn left.
content.translation: 一直走到博物馆。然后向左转。

content.text: Turn right at the hospital.
content.translation: 在医院那里向右转。

content.text: Susu, here you are!
content.translation: 苏苏，你在这儿啊！

content.text: Your cat visits me every day. She's my good friend!
content.translation: 你的猫每天都来看我。她是我的好朋友！

content.text: Yanyan can't see. She goes to school with her mum's help every day.
content.translation: 燕燕看不见。她每天在妈妈的帮助下上学。

content.text: Mum, I'm 11 now. I want to go to school on my own!
content.translation: 妈妈，我现在 11 岁了。我想自己去上学！

content.text: Remember, go straight on, walk 50 steps... 48, 49, 50! Great! Cross the road. Turn left. The school is on your right.
content.translation: 记住，一直往前走，走 50 步……48、49、50！太好了！过马路，向左转。学校在你的右边。

content.text: Mum, let me go to school on my own today!
content.translation: 妈妈，今天让我自己去上学吧！

content.text: Are you sure?
content.translation: 你确定吗？

content.text: Yes, I can do it.
content.translation: 是的，我能做到。

content.text: One, two, three...
content.translation: 一、二、三……

content.text: Be careful, my girl!
content.translation: 小心点，我的孩子！

content.text: Go straight on... 48, 49, 50! OK. Cross the road and turn left.
content.translation: 一直往前走……48、49、50！好。过马路，向左转。

content.text: I'm at school now, Mum!
content.translation: 妈妈，我到学校了！

content.text: Well done, Yanyan!
content.translation: 干得好，燕燕！

content.text: Who's the man?
content.translation: 这个男人是谁？

content.text: This is my father.
content.translation: 这是我的爸爸。

content.text: What does he do? Have a guess!
content.translation: 他是做什么的？猜一猜！

content.text: Is he a farmer?
content.translation: 他是农民吗？

content.text: No, he isn't. But he often works in the fields.
content.translation: 不，他不是。但他经常在田里工作。

content.text: Is he a painter?
content.translation: 他是画家吗？

content.text: No, he isn't. But he uses his brush a lot.
content.translation: 不，他不是。但他经常用画笔。

content.text: I know! He's a scientist!
content.translation: 我知道了！他是科学家！

content.text: That's right!
content.translation: 没错！

content.text: Oh, look at this!
content.translation: 哦，看这个！

content.text: Oh, a night owl!
content.translation: 哦，一只夜猫子！

content.text: Yes, I come out at night. But many people are "night owls", too. Do you know that?
content.translation: 是的，我晚上出来。但很多人也是“夜猫子”，你知道吗？

content.text: Bus drivers and taxi drivers work at night. They take people home.
content.translation: 公交车司机和出租车司机上夜班。他们送人们回家。

content.text: Police officers and firemen work at night, too. They keep the city safe.
content.translation: 警察和消防员也在夜间工作。他们守护着城市的安全。

content.text: Doctors and nurses are busy at night. They help people.
content.translation: 医生和护士晚上很忙。他们帮助别人。

content.text: So many people work at night. They brighten the night for others.
content.translation: 这么多人在夜间工作。他们为别人照亮了夜晚。

content.text: I work at night, too. Time to go!
content.translation: 我也在夜间工作。该走了！

Unit 2 How do you feel today.unit: Unit 2 How do you feel today (Start up)

content.text: It's my first Beijing opera show with Lingling. I'm so excited.
content.translation: 这是我和玲玲第一次参加京剧表演。我太兴奋了。

content.text: Lingling, it's Amy's mum. Amy is ill today.
content.translation: 玲玲，是艾米的妈妈。艾米今天病了。

content.text: Is she coughing?
content.translation: 她在咳嗽吗？

content.text: Yes, she is. She can't talk.
content.translation: 是的。她不能说话。

content.text: She can't take part in the show today. She's sad.
content.translation: 她今天不能参加演出了。她很难过。

content.text: I'm sorry to hear that.
content.translation: 听到这个我很难过。

content.text: Dear Amy, Get well soon. Don't be sad. We can do it next time.
content.translation: 亲爱的艾米，早日康复。别难过。我们下次再表演。

content.text: Dear Lingling, Thank you. I'm feeling better now.
content.translation: 亲爱的玲玲，谢谢你。我现在好多了。

content.text: Time for the show. I'm happy!
content.translation: 演出时间到了。我很开心！

Unit 2 How do you feel today.unit: Unit 2 How do you feel today (Speed up)

content.text: Jay gets a new ship model for his birthday. He is very surprised and happy.
content.translation: 杰伊生日时收到了一艘新船模型。他非常惊喜，很开心。

content.text: Happy birthday, Jay!
content.translation: 生日快乐，杰伊！

content.text: This is for you.
content.translation: 这是给你的。

content.text: Thank you! It's the new ship model!
content.translation: 谢谢！是新的船模型！

content.text: It's nine o'clock. Time for bed, Jay.
content.translation: 九点了。该睡觉了，杰伊。

content.text: I'm making the ship.
content.translation: 我正在做船。

content.text: You can make it tomorrow.
content.translation: 你可以明天再做。

content.text: Bang!
content.translation: 砰！

content.text: Ray! My ship!
content.translation: 雷！我的船！

content.text: Jay, I'm...
content.translation: 杰伊，我……

content.text: Jay is angry. He is shouting at Ray.
content.translation: 杰伊很生气。他在对雷大喊。

content.text: Jay runs back to his room. He is sad.
content.translation: 杰伊跑回自己的房间。他很伤心。

content.text: Ray, I'm sorry. I shouldn't shout at you.
content.translation: 雷，对不起。我不该对你大喊。

content.text: Jay, I'm so sorry about your ship.
content.translation: 杰伊，关于你的船我非常抱歉。

content.text: Let's make it again together!
content.translation: 我们一起重新做一个吧！

content.text: Jay and Ray are happy now.
content.translation: 杰伊和雷现在很开心。

content.text: The next day
content.translation: 第二天

content.text: What are you looking at?
content.translation: 你在看什么？

content.text: I'm looking at their clothes.
content.translation: 我在看她们的衣服。

content.text: Are you worried?
content.translation: 你担心吗？

content.text: Yes. Everyone's wearing beautiful clothes. But I'm not. I can't win.
content.translation: 是的。每个人都穿着漂亮的衣服，可我没有。我赢不了。

content.text: Don't worry about your clothes. Just go and dance.
content.translation: 别担心你的衣服。去跳舞就好。

content.text: OK.
content.translation: 好的。

content.text: You can do this, Lingling!
content.translation: 你能行的，玲玲！

content.text: Thanks!
content.translation: 谢谢！

content.text: She's dancing well.
content.translation: 她跳得很好。

content.text: The best dancer is... Lingling!
content.translation: 最佳舞者是……玲玲！

content.text: Hooray!
content.translation: 万岁！

content.text: Look at me!
content.translation: 看我！

content.text: She's flying so well! Oh, Bird, please teach me to fly.
content.translation: 她飞得真好！小鸟，请教我飞吧。

content.text: Oh, no. I'm not good at flying.
content.translation: 哦，不行。我不擅长飞。

content.text: Look at me!
content.translation: 看我！

content.text: He's running so well. Oh, Dog, please teach me to run.
content.translation: 他跑得真快。小狗，请教我跑吧。

content.text: Oh, no. I'm not good at running.
content.translation: 哦，不行。我不擅长跑。

content.text: Look at me!
content.translation: 看我！

content.text: He's swimming so well! Oh, Duck, please teach me to swim.
content.translation: 他游得真好！鸭子，请教我游泳吧。

content.text: Oh, no. I'm not good at swimming.
content.translation: 哦，不行。我不擅长游泳。

content.text: Why are you crying, my boy?
content.translation: 孩子，你为什么哭？

content.text: Cock-a-doodle-doo. I've got no talent.
content.translation: 喔喔喔。我什么都不擅长。

content.text: Don't worry. Let me teach you to sing.
content.translation: 别担心。我来教你唱歌。

content.text: Listen! Little Chicken is singing. He sings so well!
content.translation: 听！小鸡在唱歌。他唱得真好！

content.text: See? That's your talent.
content.translation: 看吧？这就是你的才能。

content.text: What are you doing?
content.translation: 你们在做什么？

content.text: We're digging.
content.translation: 我们在挖土。

content.text: For what?
content.translation: 做什么用？

content.text: We're making a small garden for the class!
content.translation: 我们在为班级建一个小花园！

content.text: I've got tomato seeds.
content.translation: 我有西红柿种子。

content.text: I've got bean seeds.
content.translation: 我有豆子种子。

content.text: I've got cucumber seeds.
content.translation: 我有黄瓜种子。

content.text: I've got sunflower seeds.
content.translation: 我有葵花籽。

content.text: Two weeks later.
content.translation: 两周后。

content.text: Are your seeds growing?
content.translation: 你们的种子发芽了吗？

content.text: Yes, they are. Look!
content.translation: 是的，发芽了。看！

content.text: Are your seeds growing, Sam?
content.translation: 萨姆，你的种子发芽了吗？

content.text: Why aren't my seeds growing?
content.translation: 为什么我的种子不发芽？

content.text: Oh, Sam. These seeds can't grow!
content.translation: 哦，萨姆。这些种子不能发芽！

content.text: Why?
content.translation: 为什么？

content.text: Because your seeds are from a snack bag.
content.translation: 因为你的种子是从零食袋里来的。

content.text: Let me plant a new one.
content.translation: 让我种一颗新的。

content.text: I'm Huahua. This is my grandpa. He's a scientist.
content.translation: 我是花花。这是我的爷爷。他是一位科学家。

content.text: I like staying with Grandpa. He's reading and I'm sleeping.
content.translation: 我喜欢和爷爷待在一起。他看书，我睡觉。

content.text: Grandpa often works in the fields. I like playing with the rice plants there.
content.translation: 爷爷经常在田里工作。我喜欢在那儿和水稻玩。

content.text: Look, Grandpa! I've got a mouse!
content.translation: 看，爷爷！我抓到一只老鼠！

content.text: Grandpa works hard. Sometimes I work, too!
content.translation: 爷爷工作很努力。有时我也工作！

content.text: Grandpa has two dreams. He wants to grow tall rice plants, with big grains. He can sit under them. He also wants to feed the world with his rice.
content.translation: 爷爷有两个梦想。他想种出高大、谷粒饱满的水稻，能在稻下乘凉。他还想用自己的水稻养活全世界。

content.text: I miss Grandpa. I think his dreams will come true!
content.translation: 我想念爷爷。我相信他的梦想会实现！

content.text: I love the Art Festival!
content.translation: 我喜欢艺术节！

content.text: Me too! There are so many things to see!
content.translation: 我也是！有好多东西可以看！

content.text: Are you drawing, Daming?
content.translation: 大明，你在画画吗？

content.text: No, I'm writing Chinese words.
content.translation: 没有，我在写汉字。

content.text: What are they?
content.translation: 它们是什么字？

content.text: This is an animal. Look! There are horns.
content.translation: 这个字代表一种动物。你看！上面有角。

content.text: Is it a cow?
content.translation: 是“牛”吗？

content.text: Yes!
content.translation: 对！

content.text: There are small dots on it.
content.translation: 这个字上面有小小的点。

content.text: They look like raindrops. Is it rain?
content.translation: 它们看起来像雨滴。是“雨”字吗？

content.text: Well done!
content.translation: 答对啦！

content.text: Are there more? I want to learn Chinese writing.
content.translation: 还有别的字吗？我想学写汉字。

content.text: Yes, there are.
content.translation: 有的。

content.text: Can you teach us?
content.translation: 你能教我们吗？

content.text: Of course. Let's write together.
content.translation: 当然可以。我们一起写吧。

content.text: This is fun.
content.translation: 这太有意思了。

content.text: Chinese writing is an art!
content.translation: 汉字书写是一门艺术！

content.text: For the field trip, let's have a nature hunt! Try to find the plants and animals!
content.translation: 这次实地考察，我们来一次自然探索吧！试着找一找植物和动物！

content.text: Look, Lanlan, there's a tree with red leaves!
content.translation: 看，兰兰，有一棵长着红叶子的树！

content.text: Yes, and there are some pink flowers.
content.translation: 是的，还有一些粉色的花。

content.text: Are there any birds?
content.translation: 有鸟吗？

content.text: No... Oh! Yes, there is a bird. A baby bird.
content.translation: 没有……哦！有的，有一只鸟。一只小鸟宝宝。

content.text: It falls off the tree.
content.translation: 它从树上掉下来了。

content.text: Look, Weiwei, there are two baby birds in the tree.
content.translation: 看，伟伟，树上有两只小鸟宝宝。

content.text: Yes. Let's find the teacher.
content.translation: 是的。我们去找老师吧。

content.text: Can we help it?
content.translation: 我们能帮帮它吗？

content.text: Let's call the forest keeper!
content.translation: 我们给森林管理员打电话吧！

content.text: The forest keeper comes.
content.translation: 森林管理员来了。

content.text: The baby bird is home. Thank you, children.
content.translation: 小鸟宝宝回家了。谢谢你们，孩子们。

content.text: Hey, look! The mother bird is back.
content.translation: 嘿，看！鸟妈妈回来了。

content.text: How lovely! They are a happy family!
content.translation: 多可爱啊！它们是幸福的一家！

content.text: This is a very special field trip for us!
content.translation: 对我们来说，这是一次非常特别的实地考察！

content.text: Lingling, what do you want to wear to the party?
content.translation: 玲玲，你想穿什么去聚会？

content.text: My favourite blue dress!
content.translation: 我最喜欢的蓝色连衣裙！

content.text: Oh, that dress is nice!
content.translation: 哦，那条裙子真好看！

content.text: What are you doing, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你在做什么？

content.text: I'm looking for my blue dress.
content.translation: 我在找我的蓝色连衣裙。

content.text: Oh, it's small for me now.
content.translation: 哦，它现在太小了。

content.text: Mum, are you cutting up my dress?
content.translation: 妈妈，你在剪我的裙子吗？

content.text: Don't worry. I have an idea.
content.translation: 别担心。我有个主意。

content.text: The next day.
content.translation: 第二天。

content.text: Lingling, you're not wearing that blue dress.
content.translation: 玲玲，你没穿那条蓝色连衣裙。

content.text: Yes, I'm wearing it!
content.translation: 我穿着呢！

content.text: Tom makes clothes for animals. He's busy every day!
content.translation: 汤姆为动物们做衣服。他每天都很忙！

content.text: We need clothes for a Christmas party!
content.translation: 我们需要参加圣诞派对的衣服！

content.text: OK!
content.translation: 好的！

content.text: Lovely dresses and hats!
content.translation: 漂亮的连衣裙和帽子！

content.text: My family want colourful shirts!
content.translation: 我们一家想要彩色的衬衫！

content.text: OK!
content.translation: 好的！

content.text: Nice shirts!
content.translation: 漂亮的衬衫！

content.text: I have eight brothers and sisters. We all look the same! Dad gets our names wrong. Can you help?
content.translation: 我有八个兄弟姐妹。我们长得都一样！爸爸会叫错我们的名字。你能帮忙吗？

content.text: No problem!
content.translation: 没问题！

content.text: Now we're wearing T-shirts with our names.
content.translation: 现在我们穿着写着自己名字的T恤衫。

content.text: Clever idea!
content.translation: 好主意！

content.text: Here comes Mr Bird. He wants something special.
content.translation: 鸟先生来了。他想要点特别的东西。

content.text: A birthday present for Ms Whale? Let me think.
content.translation: 给鲸鱼女士的生日礼物？让我想想。

content.text: The next day, Tom asks all the animals to come and help. What are they making?
content.translation: 第二天，汤姆请所有的动物来帮忙。他们在做什么呢？

Unit 1 What's on your plate?.unit: Unit 1 What's on your plate? (Start up)

content.text: Wow! There is so much food.
content.translation: 哇！有这么多食物。

content.text: What do you want to eat?
content.translation: 你们想吃什么？

content.text: I want noodles in soup, salad and beef.
content.translation: 我想要汤面、沙拉和牛肉。

content.text: I want chicken and beef.
content.translation: 我想要鸡肉和牛肉。

content.text: I want an apple and milk, too!
content.translation: 我还想要一个苹果和牛奶！

content.text: I like cake and cola.
content.translation: 我喜欢蛋糕和可乐。

content.text: Don't take too much! We should eat all the food on our plates.
content.translation: 不要拿太多！我们应该把盘子里的食物都吃完。

content.text: Sam, look at your plate. You should have some vegetables.
content.translation: 萨姆，看看你的盘子。你应该吃点蔬菜。

content.text: OK. Let me go and get some.
content.translation: 好的，我去拿一些。

content.text: What vegetables have you got now?
content.translation: 你现在拿了什么蔬菜？

content.text: Potatoes, a lot of potatoes.
content.translation: 土豆，很多土豆。

content.text: Oh, Sam!!! Those are chips!
content.translation: 哦，萨姆！！！那些是薯条！

Unit 1 What's on your plate?.unit: Unit 1 What's on your plate? (Speed up)

content.text: Dear Sally, That's enough! This is a bad day for me again!
content.translation: 亲爱的萨莉，够了！今天对我来说又是糟糕的一天！

content.text: Every morning, you need a good breakfast. Let's have bread, milk, eggs, fruit and vegetables. Just a few biscuits are not enough! I often feel hungry all morning.
content.translation: 每天早上，你都需要一顿丰盛的早餐。让我们吃些面包、牛奶、鸡蛋、水果和蔬菜吧。只吃几块饼干是不够的！我经常整个上午都觉得饿。

content.text: Then you often eat too much for lunch. You have a lot of meat, but no vegetables and no fruit. I get too heavy. This makes you sleepy in the afternoon.
content.translation: 然后你午饭又经常吃得太多。你吃很多肉，却没有蔬菜和水果。我变得太沉重了。这让你下午犯困。

content.text: And you always eat dinner too fast so you can go and play. You should eat slowly. I have to work hard for a long time after dinner. I'm so tired.
content.translation: 而且你晚餐总是吃得太快，好去玩。你应该慢慢吃。晚饭后我不得不辛苦工作很长时间。我太累了。

content.text: Sally, please make some changes. Help me stay healthy. Then you are healthy, too.
content.translation: 萨莉，请做些改变。帮我保持健康，这样你也会健康。

content.text: With love, Your stomach
content.translation: 爱你的，你的胃

content.text: The dress is too small for you.
content.translation: 这条裙子对你来说太小了。

content.text: Mum, don't throw it away. I can make use of it.
content.translation: 妈妈，别扔掉它。我可以利用它。

content.text: OK. Take it. But what for?
content.translation: 好的，拿去吧。但是用来做什么？

content.text: Wait and see!
content.translation: 等着瞧吧！

content.text: Grandpa, give those cans to me, please.
content.translation: 爷爷，请把那些罐子给我。

content.text: Sure, but what for?
content.translation: 当然可以，但是用来做什么？

content.text: Wait and see!
content.translation: 等着瞧吧！

content.text: Don't throw away that box, Dad! I want to use it.
content.translation: 爸爸，别扔掉那个盒子！我想用它。

content.text: OK, you can keep it. But what for?
content.translation: 好的，你可以留着。但是用来做什么？

content.text: Wait and see!
content.translation: 等着瞧吧！

content.text: Grandma, give that old shirt to me, please.
content.translation: 奶奶，请把旧衬衫给我。

content.text: No problem. But what for?
content.translation: 没问题。但是用来做什么？

content.text: Wait and see!
content.translation: 等着瞧吧！

content.text: These are houses for birds. They're also places to keep them warm.
content.translation: 这些是鸟的房子。它们也是给鸟儿保暖的地方。

content.text: I love it! Now they have a better home!
content.translation: 我太喜欢了！现在它们有了更好的家！

content.text: Dear all,
content.translation: 亲爱的同学们：

content.text: Each of us has a box of milk every day at school. We use over 150,000 milk boxes every year! But many of us just throw them away.
content.translation: 在学校，我们每人每天都会喝一盒牛奶。每年我们要用掉超过 15 万个牛奶盒！但很多人直接把它们扔掉了。

content.text: Milk boxes have three parts: paper, plastic and metal. Each part can turn into something new, like newspapers, bottles and cans.
content.translation: 牛奶盒有三个部分：纸、塑料和金属。每一部分都能变成新东西，比如报纸、瓶子和罐子。

content.text: It is easy to recycle a milk box in just three steps: 1. Open the milk box and wash it with water. 2. Make it flat. 3. Put it into a recycling box.
content.translation: 回收一个牛奶盒很简单，只需三步：1. 拆开牛奶盒，用水洗净。2. 把它压平。3. 放进回收箱。

content.text: Now the milk box moves to a new beginning! Let's start now for a green world!
content.translation: 现在这个牛奶盒走向新的开始！让我们为了绿色的世界立刻行动！

content.text: Students from Class 502
content.translation: 502 班全体同学

content.text: For Duoduo, Tutu is his best and only friend.
content.translation: 对多多来说，图图是他最好也是唯一的朋友。

content.text: He wants to play with Tutu, but Tutu is playing with two other boys.
content.translation: 他想和图图一起玩，可图图正在和另外两个男孩玩。

content.text: This makes Duoduo unhappy.
content.translation: 这让多多很不开心。

content.text: Tutu asks Duoduo to join them but Duoduo just walks away.
content.translation: 图图邀请多多加入他们，但多多却走开了。

content.text: After a week, Duoduo feels sad and he misses Tutu.
content.translation: 一周过去了，多多感到难过，他很想念图图。

content.text: “But Tutu may not miss me because he has new friends,” Duoduo thinks.
content.translation: “可图图也许不会想我，因为他有新朋友了，”多多心想。

content.text: Just then, Tutu sits down next to him.
content.translation: 就在这时，图图在他身边坐了下来。

content.text: Hi Duoduo. How are you?
content.translation: 嗨，多多。你好吗？

content.text: I'm unhappy because I'm not your friend now.
content.translation: 我不开心，因为我现在不是你的朋友了。

content.text: Why do you say that?
content.translation: 你为什么这么说呢？

content.text: Yes, I have new friends, but you're still my friend.
content.translation: 没错，我有了新朋友，但你仍然是我的朋友。

content.text: Old friends and new friends are both very nice.
content.translation: 老朋友和新朋友都很好。

content.text: Join us and they can be your friends, too.
content.translation: 加入我们吧，他们也能成为你的朋友。

content.text: Now Duoduo has three best friends!
content.translation: 现在多多有三个最好的朋友啦！

content.text: You can't be friends with Dog because you're so different.
content.translation: 你不能和小狗做朋友，因为你们太不一样了。

content.text: You can't be friends with Bird because you're so different.
content.translation: 你不能和小鸟做朋友，因为你们太不一样了。

content.text: Let's show them we aren't different.
content.translation: 我们要证明给他们看，我们并没有那么不一样。

content.text: Then we can be friends.
content.translation: 这样我们就能做朋友了。

content.text: Good idea!
content.translation: 好主意！

content.text: I am small and you are big.
content.translation: 我个子小，你个子大。

content.text: I eat seeds and you eat meat.
content.translation: 我吃种子，你吃肉。

content.text: I fly and you run.
content.translation: 我会飞，你会跑。

content.text: Er, what do we share?
content.translation: 呃……那我们有什么共同点呢？

content.text: Hey, why are you looking worried?
content.translation: 嘿，你们怎么看起来愁眉苦脸的？

content.text: We want to be friends but we can't. We are so different.
content.translation: 我们想做朋友，可做不了。我们太不一样了。

content.text: But we are friends because we are happy together.
content.translation: 可我们就是朋友啊，因为我们在一起很开心呀。

content.text: Friends play together and friends share with each other. That's the key.
content.translation: 朋友就是一起玩耍、互相分享。这才是关键。

content.text: Let's show this to our parents. Then we can be friends — the best friends!
content.translation: 我们把这个告诉爸爸妈妈吧。这样我们就能做朋友了——做最好的朋友！

content.text: Thursday 11 October
content.translation: 10月11日 星期四

content.text: Our school's going to have a girls' basketball team. Amy and I want to join. We're going to have the test tomorrow.
content.translation: 我们学校要组建一支女子篮球队。我和艾米想加入。我们明天要参加选拔。

content.text: Friday 12 October
content.translation: 10月12日 星期五

content.text: Amy is in. But I am out. I am very sad.
content.translation: 艾米入选了。但我落选了。我非常难过。

content.text: Sunday 14 October
content.translation: 10月14日 星期日

content.text: Amy is so kind. She comes to play basketball with me. I'm going to work hard. I can make it next time.
content.translation: 艾米真好。她来和我一起打篮球。我要努力。下次我一定能成功。

content.text: Friday 26 October
content.translation: 10月26日 星期五

content.text: There's going to be a test again. I'm still not sure. But I'm going to try again.
content.translation: 又要选拔了。我仍然没有把握。但我要再试一次。

content.text: Sunday 28 October
content.translation: 10月28日 星期日

content.text: I'm in! I'm so happy. I'm going to play with Amy and my other friends!
content.translation: 我入选了！我好开心。我要和艾米以及其他朋友一起打球了！

content.text: My mornings are always busy. My father is ill, but my family has little money. So before school, I have to sell things. With the money, I go to buy medicine for my father.
content.translation: 我的早晨总是很忙。爸爸病了，家里钱很少。所以上学前我得去卖东西。用这些钱，我去给爸爸买药。

content.text: It's a long way, and sometimes there are a lot of people. This morning, there are too many people. I'm worried.
content.translation: 路很远，有时人很多。今天早上人太多，我很着急。

content.text: I hurry to school, but I'm still late. I run into the classroom and my teacher is there. He is unhappy with me.
content.translation: 我赶快去学校，可还是迟到了。我跑进教室，老师在。他对我很不满意。

content.text: Don't be late again.
content.translation: 别再迟到了。

content.text: I feel sad. I sit at my desk and cut a word into it. I'm not going to be late again.
content.translation: 我很难过。我坐在书桌前，在桌面上刻了一个字。我再也不会迟到了。

content.text: The boy is Lu Xun. The word is "早".
content.translation: 这个男孩就是鲁迅。他刻的字是“早”。

Unit 5 Look into the future.unit: Unit 5 Look into the future (Start up)

content.text: This robot is so cool!
content.translation: 这个机器人太酷了！

content.text: I still need some time to get it to work. It will help people a lot.
content.translation: 我还需要一些时间让它正常工作。它会帮人们很多忙。

content.text: What will it do for people?
content.translation: 它会为人们做些什么？

content.text: A lot of things.
content.translation: 很多事情。

content.text: Will it do our chores?
content.translation: 它会做我们的家务吗？

content.text: Yes. We will have more free time.
content.translation: 会的。我们将会有更多空闲时间。

content.text: Great. Will it take care of pets?
content.translation: 太好了。它会照看宠物吗？

content.text: Yes, it will keep an eye on the pets all day.
content.translation: 会的，它会整天照看宠物。

content.text: Will it play with us?
content.translation: 它会和我们一起玩吗？

content.text: Yes, it will know all kinds of games and sports.
content.translation: 会的，它会各种游戏和运动。

content.text: Then we'll have a lot of fun. Well... will it do my homework?
content.translation: 那我们会有很多乐趣。嗯……它会帮我做家庭作业吗？

content.text: No, it won't!
content.translation: 不会！

Unit 5 Look into the future.unit: Unit 5 Look into the future (Speed up)

content.text: This city will be under the sea.
content.translation: 这座城市将建在海底。

content.text: People will live in glass balls.
content.translation: 人们将住在玻璃球里。

content.text: Sea animals will be all around the houses.
content.translation: 海洋动物会围绕在房子四周。

content.text: There will be special farms under the sea.
content.translation: 海底将会有特别的农场。

content.text: A special glass box will take people up to the land. It will go very fast!
content.translation: 一个特制的玻璃箱会把人们送到陆地上。它跑得非常快！

content.text: Life under the sea will be clean, beautiful and interesting!
content.translation: 海底生活将会干净、美丽又有趣！

content.text: This city will be on the moon.
content.translation: 这座城市将建在月球上。

content.text: It will be a very different place then.
content.translation: 到那时，它会是一个完全不同的地方。

content.text: Plants there will grow very big.
content.translation: 那里的植物会长得非常大。

content.text: People will make houses under them.
content.translation: 人们会在它们下面建造房屋。

content.text: They won't need to worry about food at all.
content.translation: 他们完全不用担心食物。

content.text: People will put on special shoes to fly around.
content.translation: 人们会穿上特制的鞋子四处飞行。

content.text: They will celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival right on the moon!
content.translation: 他们会就在月球上庆祝中秋节！

content.text: The Mid-Autumn Festival is coming. Let's make mooncakes for the animals at the zoo!
content.translation: 中秋节快到了。我们为动物园的动物们做月饼吧！

content.text: OK! Great idea!
content.translation: 好的！好主意！

content.text: Hello, children! What mooncakes are you going to make?
content.translation: 孩子们好！你们打算做什么月饼？

content.text: I'm going to make meat mooncakes for the tigers.
content.translation: 我打算给老虎做肉馅月饼。

content.text: I'm going to make bamboo mooncakes for the pandas.
content.translation: 我打算给熊猫做竹子月饼。

content.text: How about you, Amy?
content.translation: 你呢，艾米？

content.text: I'm going to make mooncakes for the giraffes. I'll use leaves and carrots.
content.translation: 我打算给长颈鹿做月饼。我会用树叶和胡萝卜。

content.text: And Daming?
content.translation: 那大明呢？

content.text: I want to make banana mooncakes for the elephants.
content.translation: 我想给大象做香蕉月饼。

content.text: They will be very big!
content.translation: 它们会非常大！

content.text: They love our mooncakes!
content.translation: 它们喜欢我们的月饼！

content.text: Thank you, children! It's a happy Mid-Autumn Festival for the animals!
content.translation: 谢谢你们，孩子们！对动物们来说，这是一个快乐的中秋节！

content.text: And Happy Mid-Autumn Festival to you, too!
content.translation: 也祝你们中秋节快乐！

content.text: Christmas is coming!
content.translation: 圣诞节就要到了！

content.text: But Dad, we haven't got a Christmas tree.
content.translation: 可是爸爸，我们还没有圣诞树。

content.text: I'll go to the forest and get us a tree.
content.translation: 我要去森林里给我们找一棵树。

content.text: This one is good.
content.translation: 这棵不错。

content.text: Please don't cut down this tree. It's our home.
content.translation: 请不要砍倒这棵树。这是我们的家。

content.text: This one is good, too.
content.translation: 这棵也不错。

content.text: Please don't.
content.translation: 请不要砍。

content.text: Why? You don't live in a tree.
content.translation: 为什么？你们又不住在树上。

content.text: But I live in the forest. Animals here need these trees.
content.translation: 但我住在森林里。这里的动物需要这些树。

content.text: I see. You're right.
content.translation: 我明白了。你说得对。

content.text: What should I do? The children are waiting at home.
content.translation: 我该怎么办？孩子们在家里等着呢。

content.text: Oh! I have an idea!
content.translation: 哦！我有个主意！

content.text: Merry Christmas, everyone!
content.translation: 大家圣诞快乐！

content.text: Dad, the Christmas tree is great!
content.translation: 爸爸，这棵圣诞树太棒了！

content.text: No one will have a tree like this. We love it, Dad!
content.translation: 没有人会有这样的树。我们很喜欢它，爸爸！

content.text: I'm Yangyang. This is my little brother Chenchen.
content.translation: 我是阳阳。这是我的小弟弟晨晨。

content.text: I was four and Chenchen was ten months old. He cried a lot and I was not happy. But I still loved him.
content.translation: 我四岁的时候，晨晨十个月大。他经常哭，我不太开心。但我仍然爱他。

content.text: I was six and Chenchen was three. He didn't listen to me and I was angry. But I still loved him.
content.translation: 我六岁的时候，晨晨三岁。他不听我的话，我很生气。但我仍然爱他。

content.text: I was eight and Chenchen was five. We could play football together. He was not a good player, but we were happy.
content.translation: 我八岁的时候，晨晨五岁。我们可以一起踢足球。他踢得不算好，但我们很开心。

content.text: I'm ten now and Chenchen is seven. We go to the same school and we help each other. It's great to grow up together!
content.translation: 我现在十岁，晨晨七岁。我们在同一所学校上学，互相帮助。一起长大真好！

content.text: The summer camp is over. The past seven days were hard but great.
content.translation: 夏令营结束了。过去的七天很辛苦，但是很棒。

content.text: It was very hot and our training was hard. We walked and ran for hours.
content.translation: 天气很热，我们的训练很艰苦。我们走了好几个小时，也跑了好几个小时。

content.text: I was very tired on the first day. But my teacher and friends were kind and helpful.
content.translation: 第一天我特别累。但是老师和同学们都很友善，乐于帮忙。

content.text: After the first day, I was much better.
content.translation: 第一天之后，我就好多了。

content.text: We also did many other things. On the third day, we cooked lunch on our own.
content.translation: 我们还做了很多别的事情。第三天，我们自己做了午饭。

content.text: We were not good at cooking, but we had a good time together.
content.translation: 我们并不擅长做饭，但是大家一起玩得很开心。

content.text: What was the best dish? It was my “tomatoes with sugar”!
content.translation: 最好吃的菜是什么？是我的“糖拌西红柿”！

content.text: After the camp, we felt great. It was the feeling of growing up.
content.translation: 夏令营结束后，我们感觉棒极了。这就是成长的感觉。

Unit 2 You can make a difference.unit: Unit 2 You can make a difference (Start up)

content.text: The four friends went to a hill.
content.translation: 四个好朋友来到一座小山。

content.text: Let’s see who gets to the top first! One, two, three. Run!
content.translation: 我们看看谁最先到达山顶！一、二、三，跑！

content.text: They all hurried up to the top of the hill. At first, Daming was at the front. But then he slowed down. One by one, his friends went past him.
content.translation: 他们都急忙向山顶跑去。起初，大明跑在最前面。但后来他放慢了速度，朋友们一个接一个超过了他。

content.text: I win!
content.translation: 我赢啦！

content.text: But where's Daming?
content.translation: 可是大明在哪儿？

content.text: They waited and waited. At last, Daming came with a big bag.
content.translation: 他们等啊等。最后，大明拎着一个大袋子来了。

content.text: Where did you go?
content.translation: 你去哪里了？

content.text: I saw some rubbish on the way. I picked it up.
content.translation: 我在路上看到一些垃圾，就把它们捡起来了。

content.text: Daming, you're the real winner!
content.translation: 大明，你才是真正的赢家！

Unit 2 You can make a difference.unit: Unit 2 You can make a difference (Speed up)

content.text: The little dog we have is the cutest in the world. Small and playful, he's always by my side.
content.translation: 我们的小狗是世界上最可爱的。它小巧又顽皮，总是陪在我身边。

content.text: “Play with me and love me. I want you with me always.”
content.translation: “和我玩吧，爱我吧。我希望你永远陪着我。”

content.text: But we can't have him for long. He'll be someone's eyes one day.
content.translation: 但我们不能长久地养着他。有一天，他会成为别人的眼睛。

content.text: I made a new friend. He was eighty years old, and he had no family.
content.translation: 我交了一个新朋友。他八十岁了，没有家人。

content.text: He owned a ukulele. So I brought over my guitar. Together the two of us played.
content.translation: 他有一把尤克里里。于是我把我的吉他带了过去。我们两个人一起弹奏。

content.text: We're not good enough for a show. But we didn't sound too bad at all.
content.translation: 我们弹得不够好，没法上台表演。但我们的琴声一点也不难听。

content.text: At lunchtime, I saw the new kid. She sat on her own. She had only the words of a book for her lunch.
content.translation: 午饭时，我看见了那个新来的同学。她独自坐着，午餐只有书里的文字。

content.text: I gave her half of my sandwich. And I had only half for me. But after I ate it, I felt full.
content.translation: 我把三明治的一半给了她，自己只留了一半。但吃完之后，我心里满满的。

content.text: It's library day again! I'm excited! But it keeps raining and raining.
content.translation: 又是图书馆开放日啦！我很激动！可是雨一直下个不停。

content.text: Mum, will the “horse library” come today?
content.translation: 妈妈，“马背图书馆”今天还会来吗？

content.text: Don’t worry. It comes every week, rain or sun.
content.translation: 别担心，它每周都会来，风雨无阻。

content.text: Did you also have library day in the past, Mum?
content.translation: 妈妈，你们以前也有图书馆开放日吗？

content.text: Yes, we did. But our library only came one time a month.
content.translation: 有的。但是以前图书馆一个月才来一次。

content.text: Were there many books?
content.translation: 那时候书多吗？

content.text: No, there weren't. It was a small library.
content.translation: 不多，那是一个小小的图书馆。

content.text: Did you like it?
content.translation: 您喜欢它吗？

content.text: Yes. Books made me happy. Now I can see the “horse library”.
content.translation: 喜欢。书带给我快乐。现在我能看见“马背图书馆”了。

content.text: Oh, yes. It's here!
content.translation: 哦，是的。它在这里！

content.text: I'm so happy. The library brings not only books but also hope.
content.translation: 我特别开心。这个图书馆带来的不只是书籍，还有希望。

content.text: Book report: The Secret Garden
content.translation: 读书报告：《秘密花园》

content.text: Title: The Secret Garden
content.translation: 书名：《秘密花园》

content.text: Writer: Frances Hodgson Burnett
content.translation: 作者：弗朗西丝·霍奇森·伯内特

content.text: What happened in the book?
content.translation: 书中发生了什么？

content.text: Mary was a 10-year-old girl. She lost her parents and had to live with her uncle. But her uncle was often away. Her cousin Colin was ill in bed.
content.translation: 玛丽是一个10岁的女孩。她失去了父母，不得不和叔叔一起生活。但叔叔经常不在家。她的表弟科林卧病在床。

content.text: Mary didn't care about others and was often angry. She was unhappy in the new place.
content.translation: 玛丽不关心别人，还经常生气。她在这个新地方过得很不快乐。

content.text: One day she found an old garden. There she met a new friend. His name was Dickon. They worked together to bring the garden back to life.
content.translation: 有一天她发现了一座古老的花园。在那里她认识了一个新朋友，他叫迪肯。他们一起努力，让花园恢复了生机。

content.text: Mary slowly became friendly and kind. She also helped Colin to get well.
content.translation: 玛丽渐渐变得友好而善良。她还帮助科林恢复了健康。

content.text: Do you like this book? Why or why not?
content.translation: 你喜欢这本书吗？为什么喜欢或不喜欢？

content.text: Yes, I do. I give the book 9 out of 10. It’s a great book about friends, love and nature.
content.translation: 是的，我喜欢。我给这本书打9分（满分10分）。这是一本关于友谊、爱和自然的好书。

content.text: What is your favourite part of the book?
content.translation: 你最喜欢这本书的哪个部分？

content.text: I love the words about flowers and trees in the book. They are beautiful.
content.translation: 我喜欢书中描写花草树木的文字。它们很美。

content.text: I went to the National Museum of China yesterday. I saw an ancient dumpling from Xinjiang! It looks just like dumplings today.
content.translation: 我昨天去了中国国家博物馆。我看到了一个来自新疆的古代饺子！它看起来就和今天的饺子一样。

content.text: What did ancient people put in it? No one knows for sure.
content.translation: 古代人在里面放了什么？没人确切知道。

content.text: The dumpling is from the Tang Dynasty. What does this mean? People ate dumplings over 1,000 years ago!
content.translation: 这个饺子来自唐朝。这意味着什么呢？一千多年前人们就吃饺子了！

content.text: But how did dumplings come to Xinjiang? At that time, Xinjiang was an important place in China.
content.translation: 但是饺子是怎么传到新疆的呢？当时，新疆是中国的一个重要地方。

content.text: People in central China went there by the ancient Silk Road. They brought dumplings to Xinjiang.
content.translation: 中原的人们沿着古丝绸之路去那里，把饺子带到了新疆。

content.text: People ate dumplings so long ago! How interesting!
content.translation: 那么久以前人们就吃饺子了！多么有趣啊！

content.text: Wednesday, 7 February. Watches are so expensive. Most people don’t have one. This morning, I bought my very first watch. From now on, I will always know the time!
content.translation: 2月7日，星期三。手表太贵了，大多数人都没有。今天早上，我买了我的第一块手表。从现在起，我随时都能知道时间了！

content.text: Friday, 16 March. Yesterday, I bought a pair of glasses. I put them on, then I took a boat to work. And I could see all the ships on the River Thames! The river was busy.
content.translation: 3月16日，星期五。昨天我买了一副眼镜。我戴上它，然后乘船去上班。我能看到泰晤士河上的所有船只！这条河很繁忙。

content.text: Sunday, 2 September. A great fire started in London this morning! The fire is now growing very quickly. People are pulling down houses in front of the fire to stop it. But it’s still moving very fast.
content.translation: 9月2日，星期日。今天早上伦敦发生了一场大火！火势现在蔓延得非常快。人们正在火头前面推倒房屋，想阻止火势。但它仍然蔓延得很快。

content.text: Monday, 3 September. I dug a hole in my garden. I put some cheese from Italy into it! It’s expensive. I hope it is safe from the fire.
content.translation: 9月3日，星期一。我在花园里挖了一个洞，把一些意大利奶酪放了进去！它很贵。我希望它能免受火灾。

content.text: On Monday
content.translation: 星期一

content.text: What are you doing, Mum?
content.translation: 妈妈，您在做什么？

content.text: I'm looking for my ring. I can't find it.
content.translation: 我在找我的戒指。我找不到它了。

content.text: Where did you put it?
content.translation: 您把它放在哪里了？

content.text: I put it on the desk this morning.
content.translation: 我今天早上把它放在桌子上了。

content.text: On Wednesday
content.translation: 星期三

content.text: Are you ready to go, Dad?
content.translation: 爸爸，您准备好出发了吗？

content.text: No, I can't find my car key.
content.translation: 没有，我找不到我的车钥匙了。

content.text: Where was it?
content.translation: 它原本在哪里？

content.text: It was on the desk.
content.translation: 它在桌子上。

content.text: On Friday
content.translation: 星期五

content.text: Daming, are you OK?
content.translation: 大明，你还好吗？

content.text: I can't find my coins. Did you see them?
content.translation: 我找不到我的硬币了。您看到它们了吗？

content.text: No, I didn't.
content.translation: 没有，我没看到。

content.text: First, Mum's ring. Then, Dad's key. Now, my coins. What's going on?
content.translation: 先是妈妈的戒指，然后爸爸的钥匙，现在是我的硬币。这是怎么回事？

content.text: I know. Come over here, everyone!
content.translation: 我知道了。大家到这儿来！

content.text: What for?
content.translation: 干什么？

content.text: Look! The lost things are all there.
content.translation: 看！丢失的东西都在那里。

content.text: Well done, Daming!
content.translation: 大明，你做得好！

content.text: Detective Sharp came to the prison. The police showed him a letter from Jim Burton.
content.translation: 夏普侦探来到监狱。警察给他看了一封吉姆·伯顿写的信。

content.text: What did he do?
content.translation: 他做了什么？

content.text: He stole many jewels. But we didn't find the jewels on him.
content.translation: 他偷了很多珠宝。但我们在他身上没有找到珠宝。

content.text: Let's see the letter.
content.translation: 让我们看看这封信。

content.text: Dear Susan, I hope you’re happy after reading these sweet words!
content.translation: 亲爱的苏珊：我希望你读完这些甜言蜜语后能开心！

content.text: I miss you and our girls, my sweet. There is so much to say. You are all so sweet. Are you happy these days? Your eyes are bright and sweet. Jewels can’t be so shiny. You look sweet in your green dress! You always look so sweet! The girls look happy in our sweet garden. Love, Jim
content.translation: 我想你和我们的女儿们，我的宝贝。有太多话想说。你们都那么甜美。这些天你开心吗？你的眼睛明亮又甜美。珠宝都没这么闪亮。你穿绿色连衣裙看起来很甜美！你总是那么甜美！女儿们在我们甜蜜的花园里看起来很开心。爱你的，吉姆

content.text: There is something wrong with the letter. But I just don't know what it is.
content.translation: 这封信有点问题。但我就是不知道问题在哪儿。

content.text: Aha, I see! Don’t give the letter to his wife. We can get the jewels back now!
content.translation: 啊哈，我明白了！别把这封信交给他的妻子。我们现在就能把珠宝找回来！

content.text: Dear Mum and Dad, It’s the second day in China for Grandpa and me. I had a good time yesterday.
content.translation: 亲爱的爸爸妈妈：我和爷爷来中国已经第二天了。昨天我玩得很开心。

content.text: The high-speed train was a surprise! It was around 15 hours from Beijing to Xi’an about 30 years ago. Grandpa still remembers that. He had a long journey then.
content.translation: 高铁是一个惊喜！大约30年前，从北京到西安要花大约15个小时。爷爷还记得那件事，那时他有一段很长的旅程。

content.text: But now it takes only a little over four hours. We left Beijing in the morning and got to Xi’an in time for lunch.
content.translation: 但现在只需要四个多小时。我们早上离开北京，赶上了西安的午饭。

content.text: The “Chinese hamburger” tasted very good! Grandpa said, “It’s still the same taste!”
content.translation: “中国汉堡”尝起来非常好！爷爷说：“味道还是一样的！”

content.text: Xi’an also surprised me. It was an old city in Grandpa’s photos. But now it’s very different.
content.translation: 西安也让我很惊讶。在爷爷的照片里，它是一座古老的城市。但现在它非常不同了。

content.text: We are going to Chengdu tomorrow, also by the high-speed train. I can’t wait! With love, David
content.translation: 我们明天还要坐高铁去成都。我等不及了！爱你们的，戴维

content.text: In the Daliang Mountains, tall green trees grow. Birds sing all around. But about 40 years ago, it was very different there.
content.translation: 在大亮山，高大的绿树生长着，鸟儿在四周歌唱。但大约40年前，那里完全不是这样。

content.text: It changed because of Yang Shanzhou. In 1988, at the age of 61, he gave up a good life in the city.
content.translation: 这种变化是因为杨善洲。1988年，61岁的他放弃了城市里的美好生活。

content.text: I want to do something for my hometown.
content.translation: 我想为我的家乡做点什么。

content.text: He moved to the mountains and worked hard to make them green. Life was very hard, but he never gave up.
content.translation: 他搬到山里，努力让荒山变绿。生活很艰难，但他从未放弃。

content.text: He broke his left leg at the age of 72. But he was back to work after only half a year.
content.translation: 他72岁时摔断了左腿。但仅仅半年后，他就回去工作了。

content.text: After 22 years, the Daliang Mountains became a green world, with over 10 million trees.
content.translation: 22年后，大亮山变成了一个绿色的世界，有一千多万棵树。

content.text: By planting trees, Yang Shanzhou also planted hope. His hard work gave people a brighter and greener life.
content.translation: 通过种树，杨善洲也种下了希望。他的辛勤付出给了人们更光明、更绿色的生活。

Unit 1 What do you do with money?.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money? (Start up)

content.text: Mum, I get twenty yuan of pocket money every week.
content.translation: 妈妈，我每周有二十元零花钱。

content.text: What do you do with your money, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你拿这些钱做什么？

content.text: I spend some on books and save some in my wallet.
content.translation: 我花一部分买书，一部分存进钱包。

content.text: That's a good choice. Do you think about the price?
content.translation: 这是个好选择。你会考虑价格吗？

content.text: Yes. I don't buy expensive things. I only buy what I need.
content.translation: 会的。我不买昂贵的东西，只买我需要的。

content.text: Great! You can also donate some money to help others.
content.translation: 太好了！你还可以捐一些钱帮助别人。

content.text: Good idea! I'll share my money with my friends in need.
content.translation: 好主意！我会和有需要的朋友分享我的钱。

Unit 1 What do you do with money?.unit: Unit 1 What do you do with money? (Speed up)

content.text: How much does this notebook cost?
content.translation: 这个笔记本多少钱？

content.text: It's five yuan. It's quite cheap.
content.translation: 五元。很便宜。

content.text: I have ten yuan. Can I afford two?
content.translation: 我有十元。我买得起两个吗？

content.text: Sure. But do you need two notebooks?
content.translation: 当然。但你需要两个笔记本吗？

content.text: Hmm, you have a point. I'll buy one and save the rest.
content.translation: 嗯，你说得对。我买一个，剩下存起来。

content.text: Saving money is a good habit!
content.translation: 存钱是个好习惯！

content.text: What's your opinion about the school trip, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你对学校旅行有什么看法？

content.text: I think it's wonderful. We can learn a lot.
content.translation: 我觉得很棒。我们能学到很多。

content.text: I agree. But I don't think one day is enough.
content.translation: 我同意。但我认为一天不够。

content.text: Maybe we can stay for two days.
content.translation: 也许我们可以待两天。

content.text: I disagree. It will cost too much money.
content.translation: 我不同意。那会花太多钱。

content.text: That's a good point. However, the experience is worth it.
content.translation: 这是个好观点。然而，这个经历是值得的。

content.text: In my opinion, we should discuss it with our teacher.
content.translation: 依我看，我们应该和老师讨论一下。

content.text: Do you believe the story is true?
content.translation: 你相信这个故事是真的吗？

content.text: I'm not sure. Perhaps it is.
content.translation: 我不确定。也许是吧。

content.text: What's your reason?
content.translation: 你的理由是什么？

content.text: Because I read it in a book. What do you think?
content.translation: 因为我在书里读到的。你怎么想？

content.text: I have a different idea, but I can't explain it well.
content.translation: 我有不同的想法，但我说不清楚。

content.text: That's OK. We can agree to disagree.
content.translation: 没关系。我们可以求同存异。

content.text: Look at this photo of the waterfall!
content.translation: 看这张瀑布的照片！

content.text: It's amazing! Where is it?
content.translation: 太美了！这是哪里？

content.text: It's in a forest near my hometown.
content.translation: 在我家乡附近的一片森林里。

content.text: I love nature. The mountains and rivers are beautiful.
content.translation: 我热爱大自然。山和河都很美。

content.text: We should protect the environment.
content.translation: 我们应该保护环境。

content.text: Yes. Last year we climbed a mountain and picked up litter.
content.translation: 是的。去年我们爬山并捡了垃圾。

content.text: What a wonderful trip! I want to explore it too.
content.translation: 多棒的旅行！我也想去探索。

content.text: What can we see in the desert?
content.translation: 在沙漠里我们能看见什么？

content.text: There are sand hills and very little water.
content.translation: 有沙丘，水很少。

content.text: Is it dangerous?
content.translation: 危险吗？

content.text: Yes, so we must prepare well and stay together.
content.translation: 是的，所以我们要做好准备，待在一起。

content.text: I want to see the ocean and the islands, too.
content.translation: 我还想看海洋和岛屿。

content.text: The world has so much wonderful nature!
content.translation: 世界上有这么多奇妙的自然！

Unit 4 We can do it!.unit: Unit 4 We can do it! (Start up)

content.text: I can't ride a bike. It's too difficult.
content.translation: 我不会骑自行车。太难了。

content.text: Don't give up! You can do it if you try.
content.translation: 别放弃！你试试就能做到。

content.text: But I fell down many times.
content.translation: 但是我摔倒了很多次。

content.text: Failure is not bad. It helps you learn.
content.translation: 失败并不可怕，它能帮你学习。

content.text: Practice makes perfect. Keep trying every day.
content.translation: 熟能生巧。每天坚持练习。

content.text: OK. I'll be brave and try my best.
content.translation: 好吧。我会勇敢，尽我最大努力。

content.text: That's the spirit! We believe in you.
content.translation: 这才是精神！我们相信你。

content.text: Thank you! With teamwork, I know I can succeed.
content.translation: 谢谢！有了团队的支持，我知道我能成功。

Unit 4 We can do it!.unit: Unit 4 We can do it! (Speed up)

content.text: Are you able to swim across the river?
content.translation: 你能游过这条河吗？

content.text: No, but I can swim a short way.
content.translation: 不能，但我能游一小段。

content.text: You should improve your skill step by step.
content.translation: 你应该一步一步提高技能。

content.text: I will. Hard work brings success.
content.translation: 我会的。努力带来成功。

content.text: And never be afraid of a challenge.
content.translation: 而且永远不要害怕挑战。

content.text: You're right. I feel more confident now.
content.translation: 你说得对。我现在更有信心了。

content.text: What's the matter, young man?
content.translation: 年轻人，你怎么了？

content.text: I often feel tired. Maybe I'm not healthy.
content.translation: 我经常觉得累。也许我不健康。

content.text: Do you exercise every day?
content.translation: 你每天锻炼吗？

content.text: No, I don't. I like staying at home.
content.translation: 不，我不锻炼。我喜欢待在家里。

content.text: You need exercise and a balanced diet. Eat more fruit and vegetables.
content.translation: 你需要锻炼和均衡饮食。多吃水果和蔬菜。

content.text: Should I go to bed early?
content.translation: 我应该早点睡觉吗？

content.text: Yes. Sleep eight hours and drink more water.
content.translation: 是的。睡八小时，多喝水。

content.text: Thank you, doctor. I'll start a healthy habit today.
content.translation: 谢谢医生。我今天就开始健康的生活习惯。

content.text: I have a bad habit of eating too much sugar.
content.translation: 我有吃太多糖的坏习惯。

content.text: Sugar is not good for your health.
content.translation: 糖对你的健康不好。

content.text: I know, but it tastes so sweet!
content.translation: 我知道，但它太甜了！

content.text: Try eating fruit instead. It's fresh and healthy.
content.translation: 试着改吃水果吧。它新鲜又健康。

content.text: OK. I'll wash the fruit and eat it after school.
content.translation: 好的。我会洗好水果放学后吃。

content.text: Great! Small changes can make you strong.
content.translation: 太好了！小小的改变能让你变强壮。

content.text: I want to travel around the world one day.
content.translation: 我想有一天环游世界。

content.text: Me too! Which country do you want to visit first?
content.translation: 我也是！你想先去哪个国家？

content.text: I want to visit the Great Wall in China. It's famous.
content.translation: 我想去中国的长城。它很有名。

content.text: I want to see the pyramids. They are amazing.
content.translation: 我想看金字塔。它们很惊人。

content.text: Traveling helps us learn about different cultures.
content.translation: 旅行帮助我们了解不同的文化。

content.text: And we can learn a foreign language, too.
content.translation: 而且我们还能学一门外语。

content.text: The world is so big. There is so much to discover.
content.translation: 世界这么大，有那么多东西可以去发现。

content.text: Have you been to a foreign country?
content.translation: 你去过外国吗？

content.text: No, but I want to study abroad in the future.
content.translation: 没有，但我将来想出国留学。

content.text: What do you know about other countries?
content.translation: 你对其他国家了解多少？

content.text: I know their capitals, languages and famous places.
content.translation: 我知道它们的首都、语言和著名景点。

content.text: I saw a museum in London. It was wonderful.
content.translation: 我在伦敦参观了一个博物馆。非常棒。

content.text: Travel is a great experience. I hope to go one day.
content.translation: 旅行是美妙的经历。我希望有一天能去。

Unit 1 Play by the rules.unit: Unit 1 Play by the rules (Start up)

content.text: Class, today we'll talk about rules. Why are rules important?
content.translation: 同学们，今天我们谈规则。规则为什么重要？

content.text: Rules keep us safe. We must follow them.
content.translation: 规则保证我们的安全。我们必须遵守。

content.text: Good. What signs do you see in the park?
content.translation: 很好。你在公园里看到什么标志？

content.text: 'Don't feed the ducks.' and 'Keep off the grass.'
content.translation: “不要喂鸭子”和“勿踏草坪”。

content.text: In the library we should keep quiet.
content.translation: 在图书馆我们应该保持安静。

content.text: Yes. And we mustn't litter. Put rubbish in the bin.
content.translation: 对。而且我们不能乱扔垃圾，要放进垃圾桶。

content.text: Should we wait for the green light?
content.translation: 我们应该等绿灯吗？

content.text: Of course! Always obey the traffic rules.
content.translation: 当然！永远遵守交通规则。

Unit 1 Play by the rules.unit: Unit 1 Play by the rules (Speed up)

content.text: Can we eat on the bus?
content.translation: 我们可以在公交车上吃东西吗？

content.text: No, we can't. It's not polite.
content.translation: 不，不可以。这样不礼貌。

content.text: What should we do on a field trip?
content.translation: 我们去郊游时应该做什么？

content.text: Wear the right clothes, listen to the teacher and stay in groups.
content.translation: 穿合适的衣服，听老师的话，成群活动。

content.text: And don't talk to strangers!
content.translation: 还有不要和陌生人说话！

content.text: Right. Rules help everyone stay safe and happy.
content.translation: 对。规则帮助每个人保持安全和快乐。

Unit 2 In the face of disasters.unit: Unit 2 In the face of disasters (Start up)

content.text: What should we do in the face of a disaster?
content.translation: 面对灾难我们应该怎么做？

content.text: First, we must stay calm and listen to the warning.
content.translation: 首先，我们必须保持冷静，听预警。

content.text: If there is a fire, we should escape quickly.
content.translation: 如果发生火灾，我们应该迅速撤离。

content.text: And in an earthquake, we should protect our heads.
content.translation: 地震时，我们应该保护头部。

content.text: Very good. Where can people go for safety?
content.translation: 很好。人们可以去哪里避险？

content.text: They can go to a shelter.
content.translation: 他们可以去避难所。

content.text: Right. Firefighters and doctors rescue people. They are brave.
content.translation: 对。消防员和医生救援民众。他们很勇敢。

content.text: After a disaster, people rebuild their homes together.
content.translation: 灾难后，人们一起重建家园。

Unit 2 In the face of disasters.unit: Unit 2 In the face of disasters (Speed up)

content.text: A typhoon is coming. What should we prepare?
content.translation: 台风要来了。我们应该准备什么？

content.text: We need water, food and a flashlight.
content.translation: 我们需要水、食物和手电筒。

content.text: Should we stay at home?
content.translation: 我们应该待在家里吗？

content.text: Yes, and keep away from windows.
content.translation: 是的，而且要远离窗户。

content.text: I hope everyone will be safe.
content.translation: 我希望每个人都平安。

content.text: Me too. Being prepared is very helpful.
content.translation: 我也是。做好准备非常有帮助。

content.text: Today we'll learn about wild animals. Do you like them?
content.translation: 今天我们学习野生动物。你们喜欢它们吗？

content.text: Yes! I love pandas. They eat bamboo.
content.translation: 喜欢！我喜欢熊猫。它们吃竹子。

content.text: I like tigers and lions. They are strong.
content.translation: 我喜欢老虎和狮子。它们很强壮。

content.text: Some animals are endangered. We must protect them.
content.translation: 有些动物濒临灭绝。我们必须保护它们。

content.text: Where do wild animals live?
content.translation: 野生动物住在哪里？

content.text: In forests, mountains and nature reserves. These are their habitats.
content.translation: 在森林、山脉和自然保护区。这些是它们的栖息地。

content.text: People shouldn't hunt them or take their homes.
content.translation: 人们不应该捕猎它们或侵占它们的家园。

content.text: Right. Protecting animals means protecting nature.
content.translation: 对。保护动物就是保护自然。

content.text: Which animal is the tallest?
content.translation: 哪种动物最高？

content.text: The giraffe. It has a very long neck.
content.translation: 长颈鹿。它的脖子很长。

content.text: And dolphins are very clever.
content.translation: 海豚非常聪明。

content.text: Yes. They can swim fast and help people.
content.translation: 是的。它们游得很快，还能帮助人类。

content.text: Whales are huge, but they are peaceful.
content.translation: 鲸很巨大，但很温和。

content.text: Wild animals are our friends. We should be kind to them.
content.translation: 野生动物是我们的朋友。我们应该善待它们。

content.text: We're going to have an art exhibition. Let's be creative!
content.translation: 我们要举办艺术展。让我们发挥创造力！

content.text: I can make a paper-cut. It's a Chinese art.
content.translation: 我可以做剪纸。这是中国艺术。

content.text: I can paint a picture of a beautiful garden.
content.translation: 我可以画一幅美丽花园的画。

content.text: I want to invent a useful robot.
content.translation: 我想发明一个有用的机器人。

content.text: I'm not creative. I can't draw or sing.
content.translation: 我没有创造力。我不会画画也不会唱歌。

content.text: Of course you can! Just imagine something new.
content.translation: 你当然可以！只要想象新事物。

content.text: Everyone has ideas. Show us your work.
content.translation: 每个人都有想法。给我们看看你的作品。

content.text: OK. I'll design a poster with my friends.
content.translation: 好的。我会和朋友设计一张海报。

content.text: What are you making, Lingling?
content.translation: 你在做什么，玲玲？

content.text: I'm making a paper-cut of a panda.
content.translation: 我在做一幅熊猫剪纸。

content.text: It's beautiful! How did you learn this skill?
content.translation: 真美！你怎么学会这项技能的？

content.text: My grandma taught me. It takes patience.
content.translation: 我奶奶教我的。这需要耐心。

content.text: Can you teach me after school?
content.translation: 放学后你能教我吗？

content.text: Sure! Creating art together is more fun.
content.translation: 当然！一起创作艺术更有趣。

Unit 5 Reach for the stars.unit: Unit 5 Reach for the stars (Start up)

content.text: Who do you want to be when you grow up?
content.translation: 你们长大后想做什么？

content.text: I want to be an astronaut and explore space.
content.translation: 我想当宇航员，探索太空。

content.text: I want to be a scientist. I love science.
content.translation: 我想当科学家。我热爱科学。

content.text: I want to fly a rocket to the moon!
content.translation: 我想驾驶火箭去月球！

content.text: Astronauts are brave. The mission is important.
content.translation: 宇航员很勇敢。任务很重要。

content.text: China has sent many satellites and spaceships into space.
content.translation: 中国发射了许多卫星和宇宙飞船进入太空。

content.text: I'm so proud of China's space technology.
content.translation: 我为中国的航天科技感到自豪。

content.text: Study hard, and your dream will come true.
content.translation: 努力学习，你的梦想会实现。

Unit 5 Reach for the stars.unit: Unit 5 Reach for the stars (Speed up)

content.text: What can we see from space?
content.translation: 从太空我们能看见什么？

content.text: We can see the Earth. It's our home.
content.translation: 我们能看见地球。它是我们的家。

content.text: Is there life on other planets?
content.translation: 其他行星上有生命吗？

content.text: Nobody knows yet. Maybe one day we'll find out.
content.translation: 还没人知道。也许有一天我们会发现。

content.text: I want to be a hero like the astronauts.
content.translation: 我想成为像宇航员一样的英雄。

content.text: Then reach for the stars! I believe in you.
content.translation: 那就摘星吧！我相信你。

content.text: This summer, we'll graduate from primary school.
content.translation: 今年夏天，我们将小学毕业。

content.text: I can't believe it. It's like a dream.
content.translation: 我简直不敢相信。像做梦一样。

content.text: I remember our first day at school.
content.translation: 我记得我们第一天上学的情形。

content.text: I remember playing with my classmates on the playground.
content.translation: 我记得和同学们在操场上玩。

content.text: We'll go to different middle schools.
content.translation: 我们将去不同的中学。

content.text: But we'll always be friends.
content.translation: 但我们会永远是朋友。

content.text: Write a message for your friends. Leave a happy memory.
content.translation: 给你的朋友写段留言。留下美好的回忆。

content.text: Best wishes to you all! Our journey continues.
content.translation: 祝大家一切顺利！我们的旅程将继续。

content.text: Are you sad about graduating?
content.translation: 你对毕业感到难过吗？

content.text: A little, but I'm also excited about the future.
content.translation: 有一点，但我也对未来感到兴奋。

content.text: What's your plan for middle school?
content.translation: 你中学的计划是什么？

content.text: I'll study hard and follow my dream.
content.translation: 我会努力学习，追寻我的梦想。

content.text: I'll miss our teacher and friends.
content.translation: 我会想念老师和朋友们。

content.text: Me too. Let's write letters and keep in touch.
content.translation: 我也是。我们写信保持联系吧。

content.text: Good idea. We'll always be high flyers!
content.translation: 好主意。我们永远是高飞的人！

Starter Welcome to junior high!.unit: Starter Welcome to junior high! (Start up)

content.text: Welcome to junior high, everyone!
content.translation: 欢迎大家来到初中！

content.text: Thank you, Ms Li. I'm Lingling.
content.translation: 谢谢您，李老师。我是玲玲。

content.text: I'm Daming. This is my new classroom.
content.translation: 我是大明。这是我的新教室。

content.text: Let's get to know each other. What is your name?
content.translation: 让我们互相认识一下。你叫什么名字？

content.text: My name is Amy. I like music and reading.
content.translation: 我叫艾米。我喜欢音乐和阅读。

content.text: I'm Sam. I want to join the sports club.
content.translation: 我是山姆。我想加入体育社团。

content.text: Great! Our school has a library, a gym and a big playground.
content.translation: 很好！我们学校有图书馆、体育馆和大操场。

Starter Welcome to junior high!.unit: Starter Welcome to junior high! (Speed up)

content.text: Look at the school timetable.
content.translation: 看这张课程表。

content.text: We have English, maths and science this term.
content.translation: 这学期我们有英语、数学和科学。

content.text: What is your favourite subject?
content.translation: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？

content.text: English. And we wear school uniforms every day.
content.translation: 英语。而且我们每天穿校服。

content.text: Let's make a wishing tree with our dreams.
content.translation: 让我们用梦想做一棵许愿树。

content.text: Good idea! I hope we all have a great journey here.
content.translation: 好主意！希望我们在这里都有美好的旅程。

content.text: Today is the first lesson of the new term.
content.translation: 今天是新学期的第一课。

content.text: I am a little nervous but very excited.
content.translation: 我有点紧张，但很兴奋。

content.text: A new start is a new journey. Do you have a plan?
content.translation: 新的开始就是新的旅程。你有计划吗？

content.text: Yes. My goal is to learn English well.
content.translation: 有。我的目标是把英语学好。

content.text: What will you do to reach your goal?
content.translation: 你打算怎样实现目标？

content.text: I will listen carefully and remember new words.
content.translation: 我会认真听讲，记住新单词。

content.text: And I will never give up when it is difficult.
content.translation: 遇到困难时我绝不放弃。

content.text: Wonderful! Knowledge and hope will help you.
content.translation: 太好了！知识和希望会帮助你。

content.text: Why do you look so happy today?
content.translation: 你今天为什么看起来这么开心？

content.text: Because it is the beginning of a new term.
content.translation: 因为这是新学期的开始。

content.text: What is special about it?
content.translation: 有什么特别的？

content.text: I can learn new things and meet my friends again.
content.translation: 我可以学新东西，还能再见到朋友。

content.text: That's meaningful. I set a goal, too.
content.translation: 这很有意义。我也定了目标。

content.text: Great! Let's study together and be brave.
content.translation: 太好了！我们一起学习，勇敢前行。

content.text: What do you do for fun, Amy?
content.translation: 艾米，你有什么爱好？

content.text: I like music. I can play the erhu.
content.translation: 我喜欢音乐。我会拉二胡。

content.text: Cool! Is there a band at our school?
content.translation: 真酷！我们学校有乐队吗？

content.text: Yes. I want to join it and perform on stage.
content.translation: 有。我想加入并在台上表演。

content.text: I love an exciting story. It is a great adventure.
content.translation: 我喜欢刺激的故事。那是一次很棒的冒险。

content.text: I enjoy painting and singing. They bring me joy.
content.translation: 我喜欢绘画和唱歌。它们给我带来快乐。

content.text: Hobbies make our life interesting.
content.translation: 爱好让我们的生活有趣。

content.text: Can you play an instrument?
content.translation: 你会演奏乐器吗？

content.text: I can play the piano a little.
content.translation: 我会弹一点钢琴。

content.text: I collect stamps. Do you collect anything?
content.translation: 我集邮。你收集东西吗？

content.text: Yes, I collect storybooks.
content.translation: 是的，我收集故事书。

content.text: That's interesting! Are you a fan of stories?
content.translation: 真有趣！你是故事迷吗？

content.text: Of course. Reading is so much fun.
content.translation: 当然。阅读太有趣了。

content.text: Family ties are very important. Tell us about your family.
content.translation: 家庭纽带非常重要。说说你的家庭。

content.text: I have a close family. We care for each other.
content.translation: 我有一个亲密的家。我们互相关心。

content.text: Who do you love most?
content.translation: 你最爱谁？

content.text: My father. His love is silent but strong.
content.translation: 我父亲。他的爱无声却深沉。

content.text: I have a brother and a little sister. We play together.
content.translation: 我有一个哥哥和一个妹妹。我们一起玩。

content.text: My grandparents live with us. I respect them.
content.translation: 我的祖父母和我们住在一起。我尊敬他们。

content.text: My parents always support me when I have difficulties.
content.translation: 我遇到困难时父母总是支持我。

content.text: Good. A family is a team of love.
content.translation: 很好。家庭是一个爱的团队。

content.text: Is your uncle a member of your family?
content.translation: 你叔叔是你家的一员吗？

content.text: Yes, and my aunt and cousin, too.
content.translation: 是的，还有我姑姑和表哥。

content.text: Do you understand each other well?
content.translation: 你们彼此理解吗？

content.text: Yes. We talk and share our feelings.
content.translation: 是的。我们聊天，分享感受。

content.text: That's wonderful. Family love is precious.
content.translation: 太好了。亲情很珍贵。

content.text: I agree. I love my family very much.
content.translation: 我同意。我非常爱我的家人。

content.text: The Spring Festival is my favourite festival.
content.translation: 春节是我最喜欢的节日。

content.text: Why do you like it?
content.translation: 你为什么喜欢它？

content.text: Because it is a time for family reunion.
content.translation: 因为这是家人团聚的时刻。

content.text: What do you usually do to celebrate?
content.translation: 你们通常怎么庆祝？

content.text: We have a big dinner and watch fireworks.
content.translation: 我们吃丰盛的晚餐，看烟花。

content.text: We get lucky money and wear new clothes.
content.translation: 我们收红包，穿新衣服。

content.text: It is an important Chinese tradition.
content.translation: 这是中国重要的传统。

content.text: Every culture has its own customs. What a wonderful world!
content.translation: 每种文化都有自己的习俗。多精彩的世界！

content.text: Is your birthday a special day?
content.translation: 你的生日是特别的日子吗？

content.text: Yes. We have a party and eat a cake.
content.translation: 是的。我们开聚会，吃蛋糕。

content.text: Do you get gifts?
content.translation: 你会收到礼物吗？

content.text: Yes, and I feel lucky and thankful.
content.translation: 会，我感到幸运和感激。

content.text: It is a happy memory for me, too.
content.translation: 对我也来说是美好的回忆。

content.text: Celebrations bring families together.
content.translation: 庆祝活动让家人团聚。

Unit 5 The power of plants.unit: Unit 5 The power of plants (Start up)

content.text: Look at this plant. Do you know its power?
content.translation: 看这株植物。你知道它的力量吗？

content.text: It can produce oxygen and clean the air.
content.translation: 它能产生氧气，净化空气。

content.text: Correct. What else do plants need?
content.translation: 正确。植物还需要什么？

content.text: They need water, sunlight and good soil.
content.translation: 它们需要水、阳光和肥沃的土壤。

content.text: The seed grows into a tree with green leaves.
content.translation: 种子长成有绿叶的大树。

content.text: Forests are the lungs of the earth.
content.translation: 森林是地球之肺。

content.text: Amazing! Plants keep our environment alive.
content.translation: 太神奇了！植物让我们的环境充满生机。

Unit 5 The power of plants.unit: Unit 5 The power of plants (Speed up)

content.text: Why is the garden so green?
content.translation: 花园为什么这么绿？

content.text: Because the plants get enough water.
content.translation: 因为植物得到足够的水。

content.text: Can a leaf make food for the plant?
content.translation: 叶子能为植物制造食物吗？

content.text: Yes, with the help of sunlight.
content.translation: 可以，在阳光的帮助下。

content.text: Nature is really powerful.
content.translation: 大自然真的很有力量。

content.text: That's why we must protect every tree.
content.translation: 所以我们必须保护每一棵树。

content.text: Do you know the dodo?
content.translation: 你知道渡渡鸟吗？

content.text: Yes. It is dead now. That's surprising.
content.translation: 知道。它现在灭绝了。真令人惊讶。

content.text: We must protect fantastic animals like pigeons.
content.translation: 我们必须保护像鸽子这样奇妙的动物。

content.text: Pigeons are clever and can find their way home.
content.translation: 鸽子很聪明，能找到回家的路。

content.text: My dog is my best friend. It is loyal.
content.translation: 我的狗是我最好的朋友。它很忠诚。

content.text: Animals are kind and helpful to people.
content.translation: 动物对人类友善又有帮助。

content.text: A friend in need is a friend indeed. Animals can be great friends, too.
content.translation: 患难见真情。动物也能成为好朋友。

content.text: What a lovely cat! Can I touch it?
content.translation: 多可爱的猫！我能摸摸它吗？

content.text: Sure. It is very friendly and smart.
content.translation: 当然。它很友好又机灵。

content.text: I want a pet, too.
content.translation: 我也想要一只宠物。

content.text: You should be brave and take care of it.
content.translation: 你应该勇敢并照顾它。

content.text: I will. Animals need our love.
content.translation: 我会的。动物需要我们的爱。

content.text: Great! Let's protect all animals together.
content.translation: 太好了！我们一起保护所有动物。

Unit 1 The secrets of happiness.unit: Unit 1 The secrets of happiness (Start up)

content.text: What is the secret of happiness?
content.translation: 幸福的秘诀是什么？

content.text: For me, it is spending time with my family.
content.translation: 对我来说，是和家人共度时光。

content.text: I feel happy when I help others.
content.translation: 帮助别人时我感到快乐。

content.text: A warm smile and a kind word can bring joy.
content.translation: 温暖的微笑和善意的话语能带来快乐。

content.text: I am thankful for the simple things in life.
content.translation: 我感激生活中简单的事物。

content.text: Happiness comes from the heart, not from money.
content.translation: 幸福来自内心，而非金钱。

content.text: So we should treasure every happy moment.
content.translation: 所以我们应珍惜每个快乐时刻。

content.text: Well said. Share your happiness and it grows.
content.translation: 说得好。分享快乐，快乐会倍增。

Unit 1 The secrets of happiness.unit: Unit 1 The secrets of happiness (Speed up)

content.text: Why are you so cheerful today?
content.translation: 你今天为什么这么开心？

content.text: Because I helped an old man this morning.
content.translation: 因为今天早上我帮助了一位老人。

content.text: How did you feel?
content.translation: 你感觉怎样？

content.text: I felt warm and satisfied inside.
content.translation: 我内心感到温暖和满足。

content.text: Kindness really brings happiness.
content.translation: 善良真的带来幸福。

content.text: Yes. Let's do more good things together.
content.translation: 是的。我们一起做更多好事吧。

content.text: If you want to succeed, you must go for it!
content.translation: 要想成功，就必须努力争取！

content.text: I failed the race last time.
content.translation: 上次比赛我失败了。

content.text: Failure is not the end. What did you learn?
content.translation: 失败不是终点。你学到了什么？

content.text: I learned that I need more practice and effort.
content.translation: 我学到我需要更多练习和努力。

content.text: I set an aim and keep trying every day.
content.translation: 我定了目标，每天都坚持尝试。

content.text: When it is difficult, I tell myself to be fearless.
content.translation: 困难时我告诉自己要无所畏惧。

content.text: With courage and determination, you will improve.
content.translation: 有勇气和决心，你就会进步。

content.text: Thanks. I won't give up. I'll persist!
content.translation: 谢谢。我不会放弃。我会坚持！

content.text: Do you want to win the game?
content.translation: 你想赢得比赛吗？

content.text: Of course! But winning is not everything.
content.translation: 当然！但赢不是一切。

content.text: What is more important?
content.translation: 那什么更重要？

content.text: Trying your best and working as a team.
content.translation: 尽最大努力，团队协作。

content.text: That's a great achievement already.
content.translation: 那已经是很大的成就了。

content.text: Right. I feel strong and confident now.
content.translation: 对。我现在感到强大而自信。

content.text: Food matters for our health. What do you eat for breakfast?
content.translation: 饮食关乎健康。你早餐吃什么？

content.text: I usually have milk, bread and an egg.
content.translation: 我通常喝牛奶，吃面包和鸡蛋。

content.text: I like noodles for lunch.
content.translation: 我午饭喜欢吃面条。

content.text: Do you eat enough vegetables and fruit?
content.translation: 你吃足够的蔬菜和水果吗？

content.text: Yes. They are good for my health.
content.translation: 是的。它们对我的健康有益。

content.text: I don't eat too much meat or sugar.
content.translation: 我不吃太多肉或糖。

content.text: A balanced diet keeps us strong. Don't be hungry or thirsty too long.
content.translation: 均衡饮食让我们强壮。别饿着或渴太久。

content.text: This soup tastes delicious!
content.translation: 这汤尝起来很美味！

content.text: Thank you. Here is the recipe.
content.translation: 谢谢。这是食谱。

content.text: What is in it?
content.translation: 里面有什么？

content.text: Rice, vegetables and a little meat.
content.translation: 米饭、蔬菜和一点肉。

content.text: It's healthy and tasty.
content.translation: 既健康又好吃。
